observation: Top: the 24 lane tiles make one continuous disc in strict light/dark alternation and their outer ends close on a single clean circle - no tile is notched, scalloped, bayed or short, and no orange flame root shows anywhere inside that circle. The centre bar is a clear open platform, the four bank boundaries are the wider ones, and the counters sit on their own tiles at the five radial stations. Outside the tile circle 38 flame tongues stand clear of the rim, all curling the same way round the ring, each broad where it leaves the board and tapering to a blunt curled tip; the hero arch closes its loop at the lower rim with the skirt running on underneath it. Iso: the tongue tops are laid back - each one falls outward on a single flat facet from the deck line to a low tip, with a straight crisp crease where the ramp meets each vertical flank and no rounding or blending into the flanks. Front: one low slab; tiles stand 0.8 mm proud of the body, counters stack on the tile tops, and the rim steps down and out. Everything rests on the bed plane - nothing floats, nothing is cantilevered, and no counter, tile or tongue intersects another. Part count, placement, proportion and orientation all match the 55-part set.
